lines.text: The disciples ask where to prepare the Passover, and Jesus sends them into the city to a certain man's house.
While they eat in the evening, Jesus says one of the twelve will betray Him, the one who dipped his hand into the basket.
Judas asks, "Surely not I, Rabbi?" and Jesus answers, "You have said it yourself."
Jesus gives them bread as His body and the cup as His blood, and after a hymn they go to the Mount of Olives.
Jesus says the disciples will all fall away and that he will go ahead of them into Samaria, and Peter will deny Him three times.
